manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
